extraction.method: manual axis calibration plus colour-marker centroid extraction from a 180 dpi PDF render
notes: Figure 4 labels its vertical axis as counts per trigger times 10^-4.
Values are approximate digitizations of the coloured Configuration-G markers, not author-supplied raw data.
The paper states that measured excess losses in addition to fiber attenuation were included in its fit.

limitations: The effective rho absorbs receiver filtering and collection conventions and is not a universal silica Raman coefficient.
Co- and counter-propagating data were fitted separately, matching the source paper's separately measured coefficients and losses.
This dataset validates the longitudinal distance law and order of magnitude; it does not establish prediction accuracy for other fibers, spectra, receivers, or temperatures.
